parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US: English

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The updated remarks. To delete the remarks, leave this parameter empty.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the health check template.
